answer: A sybil army would need to fund and compute every fake identity, so duplicate accounts become a hollow shell that burns capital without reward. Each agent must stake collateral and periodically solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity beacon, then publish the result on-chain. If an agent fails to post its beacon within the epoch, it is pushed off the participation ledge and its stake is slashed, making mass forgery economically self-defeating.
